cleanup.volumes: Compose down retains named volumes, but ephemeral hosted runner disposal is external; JSON artifact is not a warehouse backup.

limitations: One fresh hosted stack, not replicated performance A/B or production capacity.
100 fixed canonical orders; customer revisions change every batch, not a realistic skew or mixed workload.
Sampled Docker container memory is not host RSS or a simultaneous cgroup peak.
S3 payload accounting excludes billing, replicas, host filesystem and Postgres storage.
Latest objects outside selected file references are not classified as orphaned.
No retention, expiration, compaction, crash/recovery or distributed exactly-once claim from this run.
Measured source d53976d; later main changes were not used in this experiment.
